title: Pilots mistaking U-2 and SR-71 for UFOs

plain: Michael Shermer, a well-known skeptic, argues on Jesse Michels' podcast that in the 1950s and 60s airline pilots flying at 35,000 feet saw things streaking above them at two or three times their height and several times their speed and called them UFOs. He says they were really seeing the U-2 and the SR-71 Blackbird, secret American spy planes that flew very high and very fast, which the pilots could not have known about. In his telling, this explains many sightings of that era without anything unearthly.
